text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I heard, Mom. ...Did you end up bedridden 
again?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're already fine~~? ...Are you 
seriously saying that?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If you're putting on a tough act even with 
me, I am seriously never gonna forgive 
you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Take proper care of your own body, 
dammit. ...Good grief..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although Espoir City checked on her 
mother's health, a lingering sense of 
worry remained.
